'''Yarmond''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] who disguised himself as an [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassador]] from the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] using an [[ooglith masquer]]. He was present at a meeting in the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] with [[Borsk Fey'lya]], Ambassador [[Jydu]], and several other dignitaries. He falsely assured the [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]] that there was no evidence of an invasion in the Outer Rim.

When [[Finn Galfridian]] crashed into the meeting, Yarmond kicked him unconscious to prevent him from revealing his secret.<ref name="Invasion: Revelations 1">[[Invasion: Revelations 1|''Invasion: Revelations'' 1]]</ref>

He reported the capture of Finn Galfridian to [[Tsalok]] via a [[villip]] and informed Tsalok of Finn's ability to [[Vongsense|sense]] Yuuzhan Vong even when they were concealed. Tsalok commanded Yarmond to make sure Finn did not escape so one of his [[Warrior caste|warriors]] could collect him.<ref name="Invasion: Revelations 2">[[Invasion: Revelations 2|''Invasion: Revelations'' 2]]</ref> He then met his end by the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Dray (Fallen Jedi)|Dray's]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].
